auxiliary: Official public train labels only in CV and valid; train+valid in final and fresh. Remove target task values and masks completely before reading any features. Exact same-molecule other-assay values are available covariates; this is conditional validation, not globally unseen-scaffold evaluation.
selection: CV only; mean and objective >0.004, at least 2 folds positive, leave-one-fold-out selection mean >0.002. Official valid report-only. One new scaffold split refits both candidate and fixed CatBoost conditional control, requires positive blend gain >0.001.
limitations: Conditional public-covariate setting. Development labels reused; full historical ensemble OOF unavailable. Foundation model synthetic pretraining, no additional ADMET target labels. Source-control gain is not gain against full ensemble or platform points.
